review_notes: The file has one theorem and declares no simp lemmas or attributes. I checked its simp calls: `simp only [hprodA,hprodB,Fintype.card_coe] at hb` uses local hypotheses and an explicit lemma list. It does not rely on the global simp set, so I saw no unwanted expansion, competing rules or rewrite cycle. The nearby files (TailPrimeLowGroup, AngularTailPrimeHighGroup and others) repeat the same hprodA/hprodB block. In other files `largeTupleRestrictedLength_notMem` is used directly in `simp only`. I did not find evidence that a global `@[simp]` attribute would be a clear improvement. That lemma's RHS, `largeTupleGroupLength (Finset.univ\s) z`, is a plausible normal form. The consolidation is more a duplication or style issue than a simp-interface defect. I did not inspect `envelopeCutoffBilinearTail_swap` beyond its use in a one-shot `rw`. A swap lemma like that would be unsuitable as a simp lemma, because it could loop. I could not run Lean, so I made no claims about how the simplifier behaves.
